title: Oracle October 2026 Critical Patch Update Addresses 1209 CVEs
description: Oracle released its October 2026 Critical Patch Update (CPU), addressing 1209 unique CVEs with 1295 security patches across 33 product families. Among these, 112 patches address critical severity issues. Oracle Fusion Middleware received the highest number of patches. Many vulnerabilities can be exploited remotely without authentication. Customers are advised to apply all relevant patches from this CPU.
aiSummary: The October 2026 Oracle Critical Patch Update fixes 1209 unique vulnerabilities across 33 Oracle product families with 1295 patches. Of these, 112 patches address 95 critical severity CVEs. The update includes vulnerabilities that can be exploited remotely without authentication, notably in Oracle Fusion Middleware, which received 206 patches (134 exploitable remotely without authentication). Other heavily patched products include Oracle E-Business Suite and Oracle Siebel CRM. The update is the final quarterly CPU for 2026 and covers a broad range of Oracle software components.
aiImpact: The vulnerabilities addressed include critical issues that could allow remote exploitation without authentication, potentially leading to unauthorized access or compromise of affected Oracle products. The presence of numerous critical and high severity patches indicates significant security risks if unpatched. The broad scope across many Oracle product families increases the potential impact on organizations using these products.
